title: Rihanna Supports A$AP Rocky During Court Proceedings
text:
• Rihanna attended the final arguments in A$AP Rocky's weapons assault case in Los Angeles.
• She has appeared in court to support Rocky five times.
• Rihanna shares two children, Rza (2) and a one-year-old, with A$AP Rocky.
• Rocky faces up to 24 years in prison for allegedly shooting his former friend in 2021.
• During a break in the proceedings, Rihanna told her children to 'wish dad good luck.'
• Rihanna was seen wearing a black leather gabardine and tanned boots.
• The couple's children were dressed in dark navy outfits.
• Rocky, whose real name is Rakim Athelaston Mayers, was arrested in April 2022.
• He has pleaded not guilty to two serious assault charges involving a semi-automatic weapon.
• Rocky rejected a plea deal that would have resulted in six months in jail.
• Witnesses have testified that Rocky was holding a starting gun, which only fires blanks.
• Prosecutors allege that Rocky pointed a gun at his former friend during a confrontation on November 6, 2021.
• The alleged victim, Terell Ephron, testified that Rocky threatened him before shooting.
• Ephron reported minor injuries from the incident and recovered two 9 mm shell casings.
• The weapon allegedly used by Rocky has not been recovered by authorities.
• Rihanna's concerns about Rocky's potential prison sentence have been reported.
• The jury is set to begin deliberations following the final arguments.
